Players Committee card image of [[C1-10P (Chopper)]] (original printing), game text: “While aboard a starship, it is power and defense value +2 and immune to Lateral Damage. May 'fly' (landspeed = 2). Permanent weapon is Electroshock Prod (may target a character of ability < 4; target may not use its game text for remainder of turn).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/c110pchopper.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
